title: 老龄化的欧洲，愤怒的年轻人
description: KATRIN BENNHOLD2026年10月15日周二在法国波尔多发生的一场学生抗议活动。 Christophe Archambault/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images Over the last few years we’ve seen the rise of a formidable political force: Gen Z protesters. They have toppled governments in Bangladesh, Nepal, Peru and Madagascar. They’re behind India’s largest protests in years, which so far have forced the resignation of the country’s education minister. 过去几年中，我们见证了一股强大政治力量的崛起：Z世代抗议者。他们推翻了孟加拉国、尼泊尔、秘鲁和马达加斯加的政府。他们是印度近年来最大规模抗议活动的幕后推手，这些抗议迄今已迫使该国教育部长辞职。 Now we’re witnessing protests by young people in France, who share the anger of other Gen Z protesters around the world, but not the same political power. Because unlike their contemporaries outside the West, young people in Europe are a shrinking demographic. Today my colleague Amanda Taub writes about the intense generational tensions in the West’s aging societies and why they risk becoming a vicious cycle. 如今，我们正目睹法国年轻人的抗议活动，他们与世界各地其他Z世代抗议者有着共同的愤怒，却不具备相同的政治力量。因为与西方以外的同龄人不同，欧洲的年轻人是一个正在萎缩的人口群体。今天，我的同事阿曼达·陶布撰文探讨了西方老龄化社会中激烈的世代紧张局势，以及为什么这些局势有着演变成恶性循环的风险。 A zero-sum game 零和博弈 By Amanda Taub 文/阿曼达·陶布 France may seem like a nation of perpetual protest. But if you are trying to make sense of the latest wave of demonstrations spurred on by young people angry over dilapidated schools, it might help to cast your mind back just a few years. 法国似乎是一个永远处于抗议之中的国家。但若想理解这波由年轻人对学校设施破败的愤怒引发的最新示威浪潮，回想一下几年前的情况可能会有所帮助。 Not long ago, the French took to the streets when President Emmanuel Macron raised the retirement age from 62 to 64. The outcry was so intense that the government eventually suspended the measure; France’s pensions remain one of the biggest drains on the budget of a nation with one of the highest debt levels in Europe. 不久前，当总统马克龙将退休年龄从62岁提高到64岁时，法国人走上了街头。强烈呼声如此剧烈，以至于政府最终暂停了该措施；对于这个债务水平居欧洲前列的国家而言，法国的养老金仍然是国家预算中最大的负担之一。 Today’s protesters have taken to the barricades to demand more resources for the young, while the earlier ones marched to protect resources for the old. In both cases, the protesters saw themselves in a fight with the French government; it might be equally valid to say they were — and still are — in a fight with each other. 今天的抗议者走上街头，是为了要求为年轻人提供更多资源，此前的抗议者游行则是为了保护老年人的资源。在这两种情况下，抗议者都认为自己是在与法国政府斗争；但同样可以说，他们过去和现在，都是在彼此对抗。 The dissatisfaction currently roiling Europe, from France to Spain to Britain to Belgium, is about many things: schools, housing, pensions, unemployment. But step back, and it’s also about one big thing — a generational fight over an economic pie fixed in its size by the continent’s chronic slow economic growth. 从法国到西班牙，从英国到比利时，目前席卷欧洲的不满情绪涉及许多方面：学校、住房、养老金、失业。但退一步来看，这也是一场关于一个大问题的争斗——一场围绕经济蛋糕的代际之争，而蛋糕的大小已因欧洲长期低迷的经济增长而固定不变。 ‘Gerontonomia’ “老龄治理” As Europe’s population ages, conflict may be unavoidable. Because ultimately, different generations have different economic interests, said Tim Vlandas, a professor at Oxford. 随着欧洲人口老龄化，冲突可能是不可避免的。牛津大学教授蒂姆·弗兰达斯指出，归根结底，不同的世代拥有不同的经济利益。 Young people need investments in education, a strong labor market and affordable housing. People over 65, by contrast, tend to want generous pensions and social care, protection for the value of their homes and other assets, and low inflation, even at the cost of higher unemployment. (No one likes inflation, but retirees who rely on savings and fixed incomes are particularly sensitive to it.) 年轻人需要对教育的投资、强劲的劳动力市场和负担得起的住房。相比之下，65岁以上的人群往往希望获得丰厚的养老金和社会护理，希望其房产及其他资产的价值得到保障，并希望通胀率保持较低水平，即使这意味着失业率会上升。（没有人喜欢通胀，但依赖储蓄和固定收入的退休人员对此尤为敏感。） As older people become a larger portion of the population in aging societies, their political influence has also grown, and they have been getting their way. The result is what Vlandas calls “gerontonomia,” a form of “democratically sustained economic stagnation.” 随着老年人在老龄化社会中占总人口的比例越来越大，他们的政治影响力也随之增长，并且逐渐如愿以偿。其结果就是弗兰达斯所说的“老龄治理”，一种“由民主维持的经济停滞”形式。 The disease and its symptoms are widespread. In France, youth unemployment stands at around 20 percent. GDP growth fell to zero percent in the second quarter of this year. Pension costs make up approximately a quarter of all public spending, in part because the retirement age is so low, but there is little political appetite for changing it. Many, particularly on the left, have argued that it is possible to preserve pensions and increase education spending. But the question of how to pay remains. The looming threat of a debt crisis makes further borrowing difficult. And wealth taxes, while often politically appealing, have not raised much money in the past. 这种疾病及其症状非常普遍。在法国，青年失业率保持在20%左右。今年第二季度GDP增长降至零。养老金成本约占所有公共支出的四分之一，部分原因是退休年龄太低，但在政治上几乎没有改变它的意愿。许多人——尤其是左翼人士——主张既可以保留养老金，又可以增加教育支出。但资金来源的问题依然存在。迫在眉睫的债务危机威胁使得进一步借贷变得困难。而财富税虽然在政治上常常具有吸引力，但在过去并没有筹集到多少资金。 87岁的退休老人玛丽卡门·阿巴斯卡尔，她被驱逐出家门一事在西班牙引发了全国范围的抗议活动。 Oscar Del Pozo/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images The situation is similar in Spain, which has one of the oldest populations in Europe, and where protests over a housing crisis recently contributed to Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez’s decision to call new elections. While the face of the protests was an 87-year-old renter, many young people joined, because the housing crisis disproportionately affects them. 西班牙的情况也类似，该国是欧洲人口老龄化最严重的国家之一，最近针对住房危机的抗议活动促使首相桑切斯决定举行新的大选。虽然抗议活动的代表人物是一位87岁的租户，但许多年轻人也加入其中，因为住房危机对他们的影响尤为严重。 Spanish youth unemployment is over 22 percent. House prices have risen far more quickly than wages, adding to the wealth of older generations, but leaving many young people with a choice of living with their parents well into their 30s or sacrificing savings to pay a steep rent. 西班牙的青年失业率超过22%。房价上涨速度远快于工资增长，增加了年长一代的财富，却让许多年轻人面临选择：要么30多岁了还要和父母同住，要么牺牲储蓄去支付高昂的租金。 In Britain, the youth unemployment rate is lower, around 16 percent. But housing costs are steep, particularly in and around London, where most job growth is located. And the country has committed to the so-called “triple lock,” a policy that has for years ensured pensions have risen faster than wages. 在英国，青年失业率较低，约为16%。但住房成本高昂，尤其是在大部分就业增长所在的伦敦及其周边地区。此外，该国还承诺实行所谓的“三重保障”政策，该政策多年来一直确保养老金的涨幅高于工资的涨幅。 In a recent speech, Prime Minister Andy Burnham pledged to overhaul the policy, long considered untouchable. One union leader called the pledge “almost electoral insanity,” even though Burnham promised to spend the money saved on adult social care, which would largely benefit the aged, too. 在最近的一次演讲中，首相伯纳姆承诺改革这项长期以来被视为不可触碰的政策。一位工会领导人称这一承诺“几乎是选举上的疯狂行为”，尽管伯纳姆承诺将省下来的资金用于成人社会护理，而这大部分也将让老年人受益。 昨天，巴黎举行了一场要求实行与通胀挂钩的养老金的抗议活动。 Mehdi Fedouach/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images Why older people have an edge 为何老年人占据优势 Wealthy nations can look forward to more of these battles, but older people may continue to set the political agenda. 可以预见，富裕国家未来还会有更多这样的斗争，但老年人或将继续主导政治议程。 The elderly are well-placed to rally others to their cause, because they have institutions on their side, said Kevin Arceneaux, a political science professor at Sciences Po in Paris. Political parties and unions have an incentive to protect the interests of older people, who make up the bulk of their membership and voting coalitions. 巴黎政治学院的政治学教授凯文·阿塞诺表示，老年人非常擅长团结其他人支持他们的主张，因为他们有体制作为后盾。政党和工会有动力去保护老年人的利益，因为老年人构成了其成员和投票联盟的主体。 It is also easier to convince young people to support old-age benefits that they might one day receive than it is to convince old people to pay more for education that they will never use themselves. Younger generations share some of the benefits from spending on the elderly, experts say. Adult children still living at home may see pension payments as part of their household’s income, rather than a transfer from young workers to retirees. 此外，相比说服老年人为他们自己永远用不到的教育多掏钱，说服年轻人支持他们有朝一日可能领取的晚年福利也要容易得多。专家表示，年轻一代能分享到针对老年人支出的一些好处。仍与父母同住的成年子女可能会将养老金视为其家庭收入的一部分，而非年轻劳动者向退休人员转移的资金。 In Britain, Laura Serra, a researcher at the London School of Economics, has found that working-age generations often worry they will have to support their aging parents themselves if pensions are cut. In fact, France’s young people were out in force to support the 2023 protests against Macron’s proposed pension reform. 在英国，伦敦政治经济学院的研究员劳拉·塞拉发现，适龄劳动力世代常常担心，如果养老金被削减，他们将不得不亲自赡养老龄父母。事实上，法国的年轻人曾大举出动，支持2023年反对马克龙提出的养老金改革方案的抗议活动。 But with economic growth slow in much of the continent, and government borrowing becoming prohibitively expensive, choices may have to be made. And when they are, young people, and perhaps economies as a whole, will be at a disadvantage. 然而，由于欧洲大部分地区的经济增长缓慢，且政府借贷变得昂贵至极，人们可能不得不做出选择。一旦做出选择时，年轻人——甚至可能是整个经济体——将处于不利地位。 Last week, as young people blocked schools across the country, France’s lawmakers met to review next year’s budget. One of their first moves was to preserve a tax break for pensioners. 上周，就在年轻人封锁全国各地的学校时，法国议员们正开会审查明年的预算。他们的首批举措之一就是保留针对退休人员的税收优惠政策。 本文节译自时报全球新闻电邮The World。 翻译：晋其角

In fact, France’s young people were out in force to support the 2023 protests against Macron’s proposed pension reform. 在英国，伦敦政治经济学院的研究员劳拉·塞拉发现，适龄劳动力世代常常担心，如果养老金被削减，他们将不得不亲自赡养老龄父母。事实上，法国的年轻人曾大举出动，支持2023年反对马克龙提出的养老金改革方案的抗议活动。 But with economic growth slow in much of the continent, and government borrowing becoming prohibitively expensive, choices may have to be made. And when they are, young people, and perhaps economies as a whole, will be at a disadvantage. 然而，由于欧洲大部分地区的经济增长缓慢，且政府借贷变得昂贵至极，人们可能不得不做出选择。一旦做出选择时，年轻人——甚至可能是整个经济体——将处于不利地位。 Last week, as young people blocked schools across the country, France’s lawmakers met to review next year’s budget. One of their first moves was to preserve a tax break for pensioners . 上周，就在年轻人封锁全国各地的学校时，法国议员们正开会审查明年的预算。他们的首批举措之一就是 保留针对退休人员的税收优惠政策 。 本文节译自时报全球新闻电邮 The World 。 翻译：晋其角

title: 新任白宫新闻秘书在中国做过律师吗？我们进行了事实核查
description: SHAWN McCREESH2026年10月15日 Is President Trump’s new press secretary a lawyer — or did she just play one on TV? 特朗普总统的新任新闻秘书是一名真正的律师，还是只是在电视上演过律师？ Three days into her job, Katie Zacharia is facing questions about whether she has embroidered her credentials. She describes herself as a lawyer, and the president called her “an attorney.” When she was asked on Tuesday in which state she passed the bar exam, she twice replied, “When I moved to China.” 上任仅三天，凯蒂·扎卡里亚便面临了履历造假的质疑。她自称是lawyer（律师），而总统则称其为“an attorney”（一位执业律师）。周二，当被问及她在哪个州通过了律师资格考试时，她两次回答称：“我搬去中国的时候。” Huh? 啊？ The moment capped off a shaky debut for the woman who has accepted what is perhaps the most challenging public relations post in the United States. Now she was struggling to tell her own story. 对这位接下了或许是全美最具挑战性的公关职位的女性而言，这一幕为她波折不断的首次亮相画上了句点。如今，她正竭力把自己的经历讲圆。 On Wednesday evening, she told The New York Times that this whole mishegas over “lawyer,” “attorney,” and “China,” has been one big misunderstanding. 周三晚间，她对《纽约时报》表示，围绕“lawyer”、“attorney”与“中国”的这场纷扰完全是一场大误会。 “I assumed the question was, ‘Where were you after law school?’” she said, taking a quick phone call on the tarmac in Arizona, where the president was holding a midterm rally. “我当时以为问题是：‘你从法学院毕业后去了哪里？’”她说。当时总统正在亚利桑那州举行中期选举集会，她是在停机坪上匆匆接通电话时作出这番回应的。 “That’s all I could hear over the sound of Marine One,” she said. “And, wanting to respect protocol, the distance behind the president, kept me from moving closer to hear the question.” “在‘海军陆战队一号’的噪音下，我只能听清这些，”她说.“而且出于遵守礼宾规程的考虑，我与总统保持着一定距离，这让我无法靠前听清问题。” It was only her second day on the job, she pointed out. 她强调，那天只是她履新的第二天。 So here’s the truth about Katie Zacharia, not-quite attorney-at-law: She graduated with a law degree from Pepperdine University in 2011. That technically makes her a lawyer. But is she an attorney, someone who is licensed to practice law and give legal advice? For that, she would have needed to pass the bar. The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday that she sat for the California bar exam after graduating law school, but didn’t pass. The Times was unable to find a law license for her in California, or anywhere else she has lived in the United States. 那么，关于这位算不上真正的“attorney”的凯蒂·扎卡里亚，事实究竟是怎样的：她于2011年毕业于佩珀代因大学并获法学学位。严格意义上讲，这确实使她成了一名“lawyer”。但她是否是一名拥有执业许可、能够提供法律咨询的“attorney”？若想具备这一资格，她必须通过律师资格考试。《华尔街日报》周三报道称，她在法学院毕业后曾参加加州律师资格考试，但并未通过。《纽约时报》也未能在加州或她在美居住过的任何其他地方查到其律师执业执照。 During the brief phone call Wednesday, The Times did not get a chance to press her again about whether she had ever passed a bar exam. But before she had to go, she did explain that when she first began appearing on cable news, she consulted with Pepperdine’s president as to how she should identify herself. She said she was warned not to use the words “attorney” or “esquire,” but that “lawyer” was OK. 在周三那通简短的通话中，《纽约时报》未能再次追问她是否曾通过任何律师资格考试。但在挂断前，她确实解释称，当初刚开始在有线电视新闻亮相时，她曾就该如何标明自己的身份咨询过佩珀代因大学校长。她表示，当时对方告诫她不要使用“attorney”或“esquire”这类称谓，但表示使用“lawyer”没有问题。 But what about “general counsel,” would that be OK? Because, on LinkedIn, Ms. Zacharia identified herself as such for Fix California, a group led by Trump loyalist Richard Grenell. 但使用“总法律顾问”(general counsel)又是否合规呢？因为在领英上，扎卡里亚在特朗普亲信理查德·格雷内尔领导的团体“修复加州”名下，将自己的职务标注为总法律顾问。 “You can’t be a general counsel to a company in the United States unless you’re admitted to the bar to practice law,” said Erwin Chemerinsky, the dean of the law school at the University of California, Berkeley. “A general counsel implies that you’re practicing law, giving legal advice to the company. You can’t practice law without a license.” “在美国，你要获得律师资格并获准执业，否则不得担任企业的总法律顾问，”加州大学伯克利分校法学院院长埃尔温·切梅林斯基指出，“‘总法律顾问’意味着你正在从事法律执业工作，正在为企业提供法律建议。没有执照是不得从事法律执业的。” On Wednesday, a watchdog group filed a complaint with the California State Bar Association, calling for an investigation into whether Ms. Zacharia “repeatedly held herself out to the public as entitled to practice law without a license to do so, conduct California law treats as a crime.” 周三，一家监督机构向加州律师公会递交申诉，要求调查扎卡里亚是否存在“在未获执照的情况下，屡次向公众声称自己有法律执业资质，而加州法律将这种行为视为犯罪”。 And that brings us to China. 这就牵涉到了中国之行。 The White House explained this week that Ms. Zacharia moved to China with her husband, Tyler, who had a job at a U.S. private equity firm. While there, she worked on “international transaction law,” Ms. Zacharia has claimed. 白宫本周解释称，扎卡里亚是随丈夫泰勒前往中国的，后者当时在一家美国私募股权机构任职。扎卡里亚声称，在中国期间，她从事的是“国际交易法”业务。 On her LinkedIn profile, she listed nearly two years of employment at Zhong Lun Law Firm, which is one of China’s biggest law firms, with headquarters in Beijing and offices in Tokyo, New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco and Almaty, Kazakhstan. 在其领英个人主页上，她列出了在中伦律师事务所近两年的工作经历。中伦是中国最大的律师事务所之一，总部设在北京，并在东京、纽约、洛杉矶、旧金山以及哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图设有分所。 The law firm did not respond to a request for comment on Wednesday. 该律所周三未回应置评请求。 Opportunities for foreign lawyers in China are extremely narrow. Foreign nationals cannot sit for China’s bar exam, hold a Chinese lawyer’s license or advise on Chinese law. They can, however, be hired by Chinese law firms to work on cross-border deals and to advise on foreign or international law. 外国律师在中国的执业空间极为狭窄。外国公民不得参加中国的司法考试、不得持有中国律师执业执照，也不得就中国法律提供咨询意见。不过，他们可受聘于中国律所参与跨境交易，并就外国法或国际法提供法律意见。 Gary Gao, a partner at Zhong Lun who is based in Shanghai, said the firm often hired foreigners for language assistance and to help Chinese staff understand foreign business culture. 中伦律师事务所常驻上海的合伙人高俊表示，律所经常聘用外籍人员协助语言沟通，并帮助中国员工理解外国商业文化。 “They are not practicing Chinese law at any time,” he said, adding that Ms. Zacharia’s role at the firm would have likely been similar to a paid internship. “他们在任何时候都不具备中国法律执业资格，”他表示，并补充称扎卡里亚在律所的岗位很可能类似于带薪实习。 Sida Liu, a law professor at the University of Hong Kong who specializes in mainland law, said that it is misleading for Ms. Zacharia to describe herself as a former associate at Zhong Lun, because it implies that she was a licensed lawyer in China. 专门研究内地法律的香港大学法学教授刘思达指出，扎卡里亚将自己称为中伦律所前“associate”（律师）具有误导性，因为这暗示了她曾是在中国的持证律师。 “Chinese law firms can hire foreign nationals to work in their mainland offices, but such individuals are not classified as P.R.C. lawyers because P.R.C. lawyer qualification requires P.R.C. citizenship,” Mr. Liu said, referring to the People’s Republic of China. “The title ‘associate’ may therefore be somewhat controversial.” “中国律所可以聘用外籍人士在其内地办公室工作，但这类人员不会被归类为中国律师，因为取得中国律师执业资格必须具备中国国籍，”刘思达说，“因此，使用‘associate’这一头衔可能存在争议。” So what are we to make of all this? 那么，这一切到底说明了什么？ It was Mr. Trump who called Ms. Zacharia an “attorney,” and she certainly never corrected the record. She called herself “general counsel,” which was misleading at best. 特朗普称扎卡里亚为“attorney”，而她显然从未对此进行澄清。她还自称为“总法律顾问”，这至少是一种误导。 Confucius wrote in The Analects that without the trust of the people, the state cannot stand. The same goes for a White House press secretary. It is a job that’s all about credibility. It’s pretty tough to succeed if the public (let alone the fourth estate) feels that it cannot trust what it is being told. 孔子在《论语》中写道：“民无信不立。”对于白宫新闻秘书而言亦是如此。这是一份完全建立在公信力之上的工作。如果公众（更不用说媒体界了）觉得所听到的内容不可信，那就很难做好这项工作。 Kitty Bennett自华盛顿、David Pierson自香港对本文有报道贡献。 Shawn McCreesh是《纽约时报》白宫记者，报道特朗普总统及其政府新闻。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

title: 阴谋、疑团和争议：朴正熙暗杀事件电影加剧韩国文化战争
description: CHOE SANG-HUN2026年10月15日 On Aug. 15, 1974, the South Korean leader Park Chung-hee was delivering an address at Seoul’s National Theater when an assassin charged down an aisle, brandishing a .38-caliber Smith & Wesson. 1974年8月15日，韩国领导人朴正熙正在首尔的国立剧场发表演讲时，一名刺客沿着过道冲上前去，手里挥舞着一把点38口径的史密斯威森手枪。 Shots cracked. Mr. Park ducked behind a bulletproof podium as bodyguards and citizens subdued the gunman. But the first lady, Yook Young-soo, whose gentle public persona had contrasted with her husband’s iron-fisted rule, was hit in the head. After Mr. Park’s dying wife was rushed away, he resumed his speech commemorating the end of Japanese rule to a crowd erupting in cheers. 枪声响起。朴正熙躲到防弹讲台后面，保镖和现场民众合力制服了枪手。但第一夫人陆英修头部中弹。与丈夫的铁腕统治形成鲜明对比的是，她在公众面前一直以温柔亲切的形象示人。生命垂危的陆英修被紧急送医后，朴正熙继续发表纪念日本殖民统治结束的演讲，现场人群爆发出欢呼声。 The killing has remained a disputed episode, spawning conspiracy theories that the dictator may have secretly orchestrated the attack and the gunman had not acted alone, in echoes of the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. 这起刺杀事件至今仍充满争议，并催生出种种阴谋论，包括这位独裁者可能秘密策划了袭击，以及枪手并非单独行动，这不禁让人联想到肯尼迪总统遇刺事件。 Now, a movie has reignited those controversies by placing the killing squarely within cross hairs of this nation’s fierce contemporary culture war. “The Assassin(s)” has exposed the competing interpretations of a turbulent modern history marked by colonial rule, military dictatorship and a bloody struggle for democracy. 如今，一部电影重新点燃了这些争议，把这起刺杀案直接置于韩国激烈的当代文化战争的风口浪尖。《暗杀者（们）》暴露出韩国社会对其动荡的现代史的不同解读，这段历史包含殖民统治、军事独裁，以及争取民主的血腥斗争。 电影《暗杀者（们）》中的一个场景。这部影片再次引发了争议，让人联想到肯尼迪总统遇刺事件。 Mr. Park, a schoolteacher-turned-general, seized power in a 1961 military coup and ruled until his spy chief gunned him down in 1979. Almost a half-century after his death, he remains a disputed figure in South Korea. Conservatives revere him as the architect of the country’s transformation from postwar poverty into an industrial powerhouse. Progressives emphasize his darker legacy: the kidnapping, torture and execution of dissidents; his rewriting of the constitution to make himself president for life; and his ruthless censorship. 朴正熙原本是一名教师，后来成为将军，1961年通过军事政变夺取政权，一直统治韩国，直到1979年被自己的情报首脑枪杀。近半个世纪过去，他在韩国仍然是一个充满争议的人物。保守派尊崇他，认为他是推动韩国从战后贫困走向工业强国的设计师。进步派则强调他留下的黑暗遗产：绑架、酷刑折磨和处决异见人士；修改宪法，让自己成为终身总统；以及残酷的新闻审查。 Mixing real events with cinematic fiction, “The Assassin(s)” follows a journalist and a police officer struggling to uncover the truth behind the 1974 shooting. They navigate a perilous era where, as the journalist notes, “seeing what you can and writing what you should” carries immense danger. Standing in their way is the feared K.C.I.A., the Korean Central Intelligence Agency. Mirroring real history, the film depicts an agency that dictates headlines, sends thugs armed with two-by-fours into newsrooms and brutally crushes anyone, from defiant reporters to honest cops, who dares to intervene. 《暗杀者（们）》把真实事件与电影虚构结合起来，讲述一名记者和一名警察努力查明1974年枪击案真相的故事。他们身处一个危机四伏的时代，正如片中那名记者所说，在那个年代，“看到自己能看到的，写下自己应该写的”，都要冒着巨大的风险。挡在他们面前的是令人闻风丧胆的韩国中央情报部。影片按照真实历史描绘了这个机构如何操纵新闻标题，派遣手持方木棍棒的打手闯进报社，并残酷镇压任何胆敢干预的人，无论是敢于反抗的记者，还是正直的警察。 Released on Sept. 23, the movie has topped the box office and sold three million tickets as of Sunday. 这部电影于9月23日上映后登上票房榜首，截至周日，已售出300万张电影票。 The film’s creators have denied any political motive, but conservative opposition lawmakers have accused them of distorting history to portray Mr. Park as a coldblooded dictator who orchestrated his wife’s murder for political gain. The backlash has included boycott campaigns against brands endorsed by the cast, including Burger King. 影片主创否认有任何政治动机，但保守派在野党议员指责他们歪曲历史，将朴正熙描绘成一个为了政治利益而策划谋杀妻子的冷血独裁者。反弹还包括抵制剧组演员代言的品牌，其中包括汉堡王。 Right-wing activists picketed the home of lead actor Yoo Hae-jin, demanding a halt to “left-wing propaganda.” Fearing for their safety, the cast withdrew from this month’s prestigious Busan International Film Festival in Korea, and Mr. Yoo received police protection. 右翼活动人士在主演柳海真的住所外举行抗议，要求停止“左翼宣传”。出于安全考虑，演员们退出了本月在韩国举行的釜山国际电影节，柳海真还获得了警方保护。 电影主演柳海真今年9月出席加拿大多伦多国际电影节。他已成为反对《暗杀者（们）》一片的抗议者针对的目标。 Carlos Osorio/Reuters Progressives, who include members of the governing party, have defended the film, condemning the conservative backlash as censorship. They have organized group screenings and traded insults with protesters outside theaters. The Directors Guild of Korea has warned of a threat to the creative freedom driving South Korean cinema’s global success. 包括执政党成员在内的进步派人士为影片辩护，谴责保守派的反弹属于审查。他们组织集体观影，并与在影院外抗议的人互相谩骂。韩国导演协会警告说，这威胁到了推动韩国电影在全球取得成功的创作自由。 “Because it depicts such a momentous episode in our history,” said moviegoer Lee Min-ho, “I wondered which parts were factual, which were dramatized and why so many questions remain unanswered after all these years.” 观众李敏镐（音）说：“因为这部电影描绘了我们历史上如此重大的事件，我很想知道哪些部分是真实的，哪些经过了艺术加工，以及为什么这么多年过去，还有那么多疑问没有答案。” A Japan Connection 与日本的关联 A government investigation after the attack concluded that the assassin, a Japan-born Korean named Mun Se-gwang, had acted on behalf of a pro-North Korean residents’ association in Japan. It said that one of his bullets struck Mr. Park’s podium while another fatally wounded Ms. Yook. 暗杀事件发生后，政府的调查认定：刺客是在日本出生的韩国人文世光，他是受日本一个亲朝侨民团体指使。调查称，他的一颗子弹击中了朴正熙的讲台，另一颗击中了陆英修，带来致命伤。 The assassination attempt came as Mr. Park was under mounting pressure from both anti-government protests against martial law and diplomatic tensions with Japan, which was angered after the K.C.I.A. abducted opposition leader Kim Dae-jung from a Tokyo hotel. 这起暗杀未遂事件发生时，朴正熙正面临越来越大的压力。一方面，反对戒严令的反政府抗议活动不断高涨；另一方面，韩国与日本的外交关系也日趋紧张。此前，韩国中央情报部在东京一家酒店绑架了反对派领袖金大中，激怒了日本。 Ms. Yook’s death stirred public sympathy for Mr. Park, allowing him to link the attack, however tenuously, to Japan. 陆英修之死激起了公众对朴正熙的同情，也让他得以将这起袭击与日本联系起来，尽管这种关联十分牵强。 1974年11月13日，文世光出庭受审。他因枪击导致陆英修死亡被判处死刑。 Kim Chon Kil/Associated Press Mourners wailed as they watched her chrysanthemum-covered hearse move through central Seoul. Men severed their fingers to write anti-Japanese slogans in blood. Crowds stormed the Japanese Embassy, tearing down its flag and setting a car ablaze. Mr. Mun was hanged on Dec. 20, 1974, three days after being convicted of “murder with intent to commit insurrection” and six days shy of his 23rd birthday. 哀悼者在覆盖着菊花的灵车缓缓穿过首尔市中心时痛哭失声。有人砍断手指，用血写下反日标语。人群冲击日本大使馆，扯下使馆旗帜，并点燃了一辆汽车。文世光于1974年12月20日被处以绞刑，此前三天他被判“意图叛乱的谋杀罪”，再过六天，就是他23岁生日。 Yet questions persisted, fueled by the case’s extraordinary circumstances. 然而，这起案件的种种不同寻常之处使疑问始终挥之不去。 Mr. Mun told investigators that he had stolen the pistol from a Japanese police station. He obtained a South Korean visa using a fake Japanese passport, smuggled the weapon through the airports of both countries inside a radio set and entered a presidential event without the required government-issued identification tag. 文世光对调查人员说，那把手枪是他从日本一个派出所偷来的。他用伪造的日本护照取得了韩国签证，把枪藏在一台收音机里，蒙混过了两国的机场，并在没有政府签发的必要身份识别证件的情况下进入总统出席的活动现场。 Missing Bullets? 消失的子弹？ Investigators said seven shots were heard that day, but not all have been fully accounted for. Officials said Mr. Mun fired four rounds and that a presidential bodyguard also shot, killing a high school student in the audience. At trial, Mr. Mun denied firing at Ms. Yook. The bullet that killed her has never been made public, and no ballistic test of it is known to exist. Under Mr. Park’s grip on the flow of information, the official account stood despite those gaps. 调查人员称，当天现场共响起七声枪响，但并没有找到所有子弹的去向。官员称，文世光开了四枪，一名总统保镖也开了枪，打死了观众席上的一名高中生。审判期间，文世光否认自己向陆英修开枪。导致她死亡的子弹从未对外公布，也没有已知的弹道检测记录。在朴正熙严密控制信息传播的情况下，尽管存在这些疑点，官方说法依然被奉为定论。 In 1989, a retired police forensics officer, Lee Geun-woo, testified that Mr. Park’s presidential security service had removed bullets from the scene before his team reached the theater. He doubted that any of Mr. Mun’s rounds had killed Ms. Yook. 1989年，退休的警方鉴证人员李根宇（音）作证称，在他的团队抵达剧场之前，朴正熙的总统警卫机构已经从现场取走了子弹。他怀疑陆英修并非死于文世光射出的子弹。 Hur Jin-ho, the movie’s director, said that television programs in the early 2000s, which explored unanswered questions about the shooting, led him to believe there may have been more than one assassin. “That’s why I put the ‘s’ in parentheses in the film’s title,” he said. 影片导演许秦豪表示，2000年代初的一些电视节目探讨了这起枪击案尚未解开的疑团，让他开始相信，刺客可能不止一人。“所以我在电影英文片名中把表示复数的字母‘s’放进了括号里，”他说。 导演许秦豪今年9月在多伦多。他表示，自己受到有关这起枪击事件的电视节目的启发。 Carlos Osorio/Reuters His film does not identify Ms. Yook’s killer, but through its characters it challenges the official narrative: Did Mr. Mun have an accomplice? Was a second gunman targeting Ms. Yook while Mr. Mun served as a pawn? Could Mr. Park have been involved in a plot that led to her death? 影片没有指出究竟是谁杀害了陆英修，但通过片中人物对官方说法提出了质疑：文世光是否有同伙？他是否只是一枚棋子，另有一名枪手以陆英修为目标？朴正熙是否可能参与了一场最终导致妻子丧命的阴谋？ The controversy surrounding the film reflects a broader political struggle over how South Koreans remembered their history. 围绕这部电影的争议折射出韩国社会在如何看待和解读本国历史的问题上更广泛的政治角力。 Left-leaning governments have passed laws criminalizing “false” narratives about two events of particular significance to progressives: the 1980 military massacre of pro-democracy demonstrators in the city of Gwangju and the suffering of Korean “comfort women,” who were forced into sexual slavery by Japan’s military during World War II. 左倾政府曾通过法律，将散布有关两起历史事件的“虚假”说法定为犯罪（这两起事件对进步派而言具有特殊意义）。一是1980年军方在光州屠杀支持民主的示威者，二是“二战”期间被日本军队强迫充当性奴隶的韩国“慰安妇”所遭受的苦难。 In recent years, some on the political right have portrayed the comfort women as prostitutes and the Gwangju uprising as a “riot” instigated by North Korea. The right-wing attacks on “The Assassin(s)” are part of a broader backlash against what conservatives see as progressive attempts to dictate how history is told. 近年来，部分右翼人士将慰安妇描述为妓女，并把光州起义称为朝鲜煽动的“暴乱”。右翼对《暗杀者（们）》的攻击是保守派更广泛反弹的一部分。他们认为，进步派正试图控制历史的叙述方式。 “It is a horrific hypocrisy to sanctify and protect, through the threat of imprisonment, only the history they have chosen,” said Na Kyung-won, a conservative lawmaker. “只保护并神圣化他们选定的历史，还用监禁相威胁，这是极其可怕的虚伪行径，”保守派议员罗景垣说。 1977年，朴槿惠（左）在首尔与父亲、实行铁腕统治的总统朴正熙交谈。她后来当选韩国总统，但因卷入丑闻遭到弹劾。 Reuters Park Geun-hye, Mr. Park’s daughter who was elected president decades later and impeached over a corruption scandal, has remained silent on the film. Through an aide, however, she released a handwritten letter from her late father. 朴正熙的女儿朴槿惠几十年后当选总统，后来因腐败丑闻遭到弹劾。她一直没有就这部电影公开表态。不过，她通过一名助手公布了已故父亲的一封亲笔信。 “Your mother took the fatal bullet meant for me,” Mr. Park wrote. “I often wonder how much better it would have been had I been the one hit while your mother survived.” 朴正熙在信中写道：“你母亲替我挡下了那颗致命的子弹。我常常想，如果中弹的是我，而你母亲活了下来，该有多好。” Choe Sang-Hun是时报驻首尔首席记者，报道韩国和朝鲜新闻。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

The Directors Guild of Korea has warned of a threat to the creative freedom driving South Korean cinema’s global success. 包括执政党成员在内的进步派人士为影片辩护，谴责保守派的反弹属于审查。他们组织集体观影，并与在影院外抗议的人互相谩骂。韩国导演协会 警告 说，这威胁到了推动韩国电影在全球取得成功的创作自由。 “Because it depicts such a momentous episode in our history,” said moviegoer Lee Min-ho, “I wondered which parts were factual, which were dramatized and why so many questions remain unanswered after all these years.” 观众李敏镐（音）说：“因为这部电影描绘了我们历史上如此重大的事件，我很想知道哪些部分是真实的，哪些经过了艺术加工，以及为什么这么多年过去，还有那么多疑问没有答案。” A Japan Connection 与日本的关联 A government investigation after the attack concluded that the assassin, a Japan-born Korean named Mun Se-gwang, had acted on behalf of a pro-North Korean residents’ association in Japan. It said that one of his bullets struck Mr. Park’s podium while another fatally wounded Ms. Yook. 暗杀事件发生后，政府的调查认定：刺客是在日本出生的韩国人文世光，他是受日本一个亲朝侨民团体指使。调查称，他的一颗子弹击中了朴正熙的讲台，另一颗击中了陆英修，带来致命伤。 The assassination attempt came as Mr. Park was under mounting pressure from both anti-government protests against martial law and diplomatic tensions with Japan, which was angered after the K.C.I.A. abducted opposition leader Kim Dae-jung from a Tokyo hotel. 这起暗杀未遂事件发生时，朴正熙正面临越来越大的压力。一方面，反对戒严令的反政府抗议活动不断高涨；另一方面，韩国与日本的外交关系也日趋紧张。此前，韩国中央情报部在东京一家酒店绑架了反对派领袖金大中，激怒了日本。 Ms. Yook’s death stirred public sympathy for Mr. Park, allowing him to link the attack, however tenuously, to Japan. 陆英修之死激起了公众对朴正熙的同情，也让他得以将这起袭击与日本联系起来，尽管这种关联十分牵强。 1974年11月13日，文世光出庭受审。他因枪击导致陆英修死亡被判处死刑。 Kim Chon Kil/Associated Press Mourners wailed as they watched her chrysanthemum-covered hearse move through central Seoul. Men severed their fingers to write anti-Japanese slogans in blood. Crowds stormed the Japanese Embassy, tearing down its flag and setting a car ablaze. Mr. Mun was hanged on Dec. 20, 1974, three days after being convicted of “murder with intent to commit insurrection” and six days shy of his 23rd birthday. 哀悼者在覆盖着菊花的灵车缓缓穿过首尔市中心时痛哭失声。有人砍断手指，用血写下反日标语。人群冲击日本大使馆，扯下使馆旗帜，并点燃了一辆汽车。文世光于1974年12月20日被处以绞刑，此前三天他被判“意图叛乱的谋杀罪”，再过六天，就是他23岁生日。 Yet questions persisted, fueled by the case’s extraordinary circumstances. 然而，这起案件的种种不同寻常之处使疑问始终挥之不去。 Mr. Mun told investigators that he had stolen the pistol from a Japanese police station. He obtained a South Korean visa using a fake Japanese passport, smuggled the weapon through the airports of both countries inside a radio set and entered a presidential event without the required government-issued identification tag. 文世光对调查人员说，那把手枪是他从日本一个派出所偷来的。他用伪造的日本护照取得了韩国签证，把枪藏在一台收音机里，蒙混过了两国的机场，并在没有政府签发的必要身份识别证件的情况下进入总统出席的活动现场。 Missing Bullets? 消失的子弹？ Investigators said seven shots were heard that day, but not all have been fully accounted for. Officials said Mr. Mun fired four rounds and that a presidential bodyguard also shot, killing a high school student in the audience. At trial, Mr. Mun denied firing at Ms. Yook. The bullet that killed her has never been made public, and no ballistic test of it is known to exist. Under Mr. Park’s grip on the flow of information, the official account stood despite those gaps. 调查人员称，当天现场共响起七声枪响，但并没有找到所有子弹的去向。官员称，文世光开了四枪，一名总统保镖也开了枪，打死了观众席上的一名高中生。审判期间，文世光否认自己向陆英修开枪。导致她死亡的子弹从未对外公布，也没有已知的弹道检测记录。在朴正熙严密控制信息传播的情况下，尽管存在这些疑点，官方说法依然被奉为定论。 In 1989, a retired police forensics officer, Lee Geun-woo, testified that Mr. Park’s presidential security service had removed bullets from the scene before his team reached the theater. He doubted that any of Mr. Mun’s rounds had killed Ms. Yook. 1989年，退休的警方鉴证人员李根宇（音）作证称，在他的团队抵达剧场之前，朴正熙的总统警卫机构已经从现场取走了子弹。他怀疑陆英修并非死于文世光射出的子弹。 Hur Jin-ho, the movie’s director, said that television programs in the early 2000s, which explored unanswered questions about the shooting, led him to believe there may have been more than one assassin. “That’s why I put the ‘s’ in parentheses in the film’s title,” he said. 影片导演许秦豪表示，2000年代初的一些电视节目探讨了这起枪击案尚未解开的疑团，让他开始相信，刺客可能不止一人。“所以我在电影英文片名中把表示复数的字母‘s’放进了括号里，”他说。 导演许秦豪今年9月在多伦多。他表示，自己受到有关这起枪击事件的电视节目的启发。 Carlos Osorio/Reuters His film does not identify Ms. Yook’s killer, but through its characters it challenges the official narrative: Did Mr. Mun have an accomplice? Was a second gunman targeting Ms. Yook while Mr. Mun served as a pawn? Could Mr. Park have been involved in a plot that led to her death? 影片没有指出究竟是谁杀害了陆英修，但通过片中人物对官方说法提出了质疑：文世光是否有同伙？他是否只是一枚棋子，另有一名枪手以陆英修为目标？朴正熙是否可能参与了一场最终导致妻子丧命的阴谋？ The controversy surrounding the film reflects a broader political struggle over how South Koreans remembered their history. 围绕这部电影的争议折射出韩国社会在如何看待和解读本国历史的问题上更广泛的政治角力。 Left-leaning governments have passed laws criminalizing “false” narratives about two events of particular significance to progressives: the 1980 military massacre of pro-democracy demonstrators in the city of Gwangju and the suffering of Korean “comfort women,” who were forced into sexual slavery by Japan’s military during World War II. 左倾政府曾通过法律， 将散布有关两起历史事件的“虚假”说法定为犯罪 （这两起事件对进步派而言具有特殊意义）。一是1980年军方在光州屠杀支持民主的示威者，二是“二战”期间被日本军队强迫充当性奴隶的 韩国“慰安妇” 所遭受的苦难。 In recent years, some on the political right have portrayed the comfort women as prostitutes and the Gwangju uprising as a “riot” instigated by North Korea. The right-wing attacks on “The Assassin(s)” are part of a broader backlash against what conservatives see as progressive attempts to dictate how history is told. 近年来，部分右翼人士将慰安妇描述为妓女，并把光州起义称为朝鲜煽动的“暴乱”。右翼对《暗杀者（们）》的攻击是保守派更广泛反弹的一部分。他们认为，进步派正试图控制历史的叙述方式。 “It is a horrific hypocrisy to sanctify and protect, through the threat of imprisonment, only the history they have chosen,” said Na Kyung-won , a conservative lawmaker. “只保护并神圣化他们选定的历史，还用监禁相威胁，这是极其可怕的虚伪行径，”保守派议员 罗景垣 说。 1977年，朴槿惠（左）在首尔与父亲、实行铁腕统治的总统朴正熙交谈。她后来当选韩国总统，但因卷入丑闻遭到弹劾。 Reuters Park Geun-hye , Mr. Park’s daughter who was elected president decades later and impeached over a corruption scandal, has remained silent on the film. Through an aide, however, she released a handwritten letter from her late father. 朴正熙的女儿 朴槿惠 几十年后当选总统，后来因腐败丑闻遭到弹劾。她一直没有就这部电影公开表态。不过，她通过一名助手公布了已故父亲的一封亲笔信。 “Your mother took the fatal bullet meant for me,” Mr. Park wrote. “I often wonder how much better it would have been had I been the one hit while your mother survived.” 朴正熙在信中写道：“你母亲替我挡下了那颗致命的子弹。我常常想，如果中弹的是我，而你母亲活了下来，该有多好。” Choe Sang-Hun 是时报驻首尔首席记者，报道韩国和朝鲜新闻。 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

title: morluto/rea
description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries. https://rea.tools English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Türkçe · Русский · Tiếng Việt · ไทย · Deutsch · Español · Français · Українська · Polski · Português (Brasil) · العربية · فارسی · Bahasa Indonesia · Italiano · Ελληνικά REA: Reverse Engineer Anything One MCP for reverse engineering across binaries, applications, and runtime behavior. See a feature you like. Understand how it works, down to the binary level. Website · Guides · Showcases Quick start · How REA works · What you can analyze · Showcases · FAQ · Documentation npx rea-agents setup Important Get REA from morluto/rea, rea.tools, or the rea-agents npm package. Follow the installation and release links from these official sources. A similar repository name or copied README does not establish that a download is official. Join the Reverse Engineering Community Discord · Q&A · Show and Tell See a feature in an app that you want in your own product? Ask your agent to investigate it with REA. It can inspect the app without its source code, explain how the feature works, show the evidence, and build a version for your project. REA connects your agent to tools for inspecting native binaries, JavaScript and Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. You can also use the same tools from your terminal. Analysis runs locally, and results include the evidence and limitations behind each conclusion. Setup registers REA with your agent and installs matching workflow instructions. Native analysis can use an existing Hopper, Ghidra, or IDA installation; setup can optionally install Hopper with approval. Static JavaScript analysis needs no native analysis engine. Visit the REA website for setup instructions, illustrated guides, and real case studies. Quick start On Linux, Ghidra, JADX, firmware tool launches and static JavaScript/Electron analysis require a procps-compatible ps on REA's PATH for process ownership checks. Recovery steps are in docs/installation.md under "Linux owned-process prerequisite". Set up your agent With Node.js and npm installed, run: npx rea-agents setup Choose your agents, review the proposed changes, and approve them. Setup adds REA's MCP server and matching workflow instructions, with backups of existing configuration. Restart your agent afterward. Setup supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Grok Build and other agents. See installation and setup for provider configuration and manual MCP registration. Ask your agent Understand how search works in the Notes app, show me the evidence, and build a similar feature for my project. Replace Notes with your target app and the feature you want to understand. Use the terminal Inspect an extracted JavaScript/Electron app directory or ASAR: npx -y rea-agents@latest analyze-javascript-application /absolute/path/to/app --json The result includes modules, imports, Electron boundaries and their evidence. Replace the path with your target, such as "D:/apps/example" on Windows. To install the rea command for regular use: npm install --global rea-agents rea --help For native analysis, configure a provider first. See the CLI and Evidence guide for native commands, provider selection, snapshots and scripting. Update REA REA changes quickly, and new releases include frequent bug fixes. Keep your installation up to date. For a CLI installed with npm install --global or bun add --global: rea update Bun global updates require Bun 1.2.17 or later. With an older Bun release, upgrade Bun manually before running rea update. To refresh your agent registrations and skill, run the setup command printed by the update. If you use npx, update your agent setup with: npx rea-agents@latest setup Review the setup changes and restart your agent. For one-off CLI commands, use npx rea-agents@latest followed by the command. With Bun, use bunx rea-agents@latest in place of npx rea-agents@latest. How REA works Your agent calls REA through MCP to inspect the target and trace relevant code. REA returns findings with their evidence. The agent uses them to ask follow-up questions, explain the behavior, or write and test an implementation. CLI commands use the same workflows. Open the full-size figure. What you can analyze REA requires Node.js 22.x (>=22.19), 24.x (>=24.11), or 26+, plus npm. Additional tools and host support depend on the target: Target What REA returns Requirements and guide Native binaries Pseudocode, assembly, strings, symbols, calls and references Hopper, Ghidra or IDA; native analysis Offline ELF layout Sections, segments, original symbols/relocations and static mitigation candidates Caller-supplied pwntools on Linux x64; binary diagnostics Go binaries Embedded compiler version, modules, replacements and build settings Built-in static ELF/PE/thin Mach-O inspection; no Go installation required Rust binaries Embedded cargo-auditable crate names, versions, sources and dependency edges Built-in static ELF/PE/thin Mach-O inspection; Rust binaries WASM artifact Validation, sections, exact import/export WAT forms and decoded WAT Caller-supplied WABT 1.0.42; inspect_wasm_artifact EVM bytecode Dispatch selectors, byte offsets, inferred arguments and mutability Local raw/hex carrier on Linux x64; offline EVM guide SQLite databases Tables, columns, indexes, views, triggers and selected ordinary-table rows Local database/WAL snapshot; Node.js 24.x >=24.15 or 26+ with native SQLite limits Recorded Linux crashes Raw notes, every recorded thread's registers/signals and optional mapping candidates Caller-supplied pwntools on Linux x64; optional GDB/pwndbg; recorded crashes JavaScript / Electron Modules, imports, source maps, routes, IPC and native add-on relationships Node.js and npm; Linux: procps-compatible ps; application analysis Websites Page structure, scripts, network observations and requested screenshots A Chrome-family browser; browser analysis Saved network captures Requests, responses, exposed payloads and source locations HAR or Fiddler Everywhere SAZ; mitmdump on Linux for native mitmproxy; capture guide .NET assemblies Metadata, CIL instructions, declared native dependencies and build comparisons None (static only); managed-code guide Android APKs Manifest declarations, classes, decompiled methods and references Headless JADX and a full JDK on Linux/macOS/Windows x64; Android guide Android devices Devices, packages, processes, logs, dumps, screen captures, and APK/file transfers Caller-supplied adb (emulator or hardware); ADB guide JEB projects Engine-backed project units, artifact digests and type/method pseudo-code A caller-started JEB client serving MCP, selected with REA_JEB_MCP_URL; JEB guide Android resources Decoded manifest, string tables, locales and version facts Caller-supplied Apktool launcher; resource guide Flutter apps Dart snapshot hash, per-ABI library digests and engine build provenance None (static APK parsing); Flutter guide Firmware Regions, extraction results and native-analysis handoffs Binwalk / Unblob on Linux; firmware guide Recorded packets Selected fields, repeated values, filters and decode-as rules Linux: TShark 4.x + prlimit; capture guide Packet summaries Endpoints, DNS, TLS SNI, protocol distribution and HTTP requests Caller-supplied tshark and capinfos (Linux-verified); pcap guide Recorded logic signals Decoder annotations, sample ranges and diagnostics Linux: sigrok-cli 0.7.2 + prlimit; signal recordings Packages and resources File inventories, digests, plists, Apple bundle anatomy and extracted resources Artifact and JavaScript guide, Apple applications Process behavior Terminal output, interactions, exit and filesystem observations, and run comparisons Linux/macOS with a native PTY; process capture Static JavaScript and .NET inspection read the supplied files without running the application. Runtime capture runs or interacts with the selected target using your user permissions; each runtime guide describes its effects. For offline native-binary inspection, REA also supports caller-supplied GNU objdump and Rizin. See the reverse-engineering tools guide for provider setup, CLI commands, and Evidence limitations. REA does not install or update either provider. Native formats and host support vary by provider. See Hopper and Ghidra setup, the IDA guide (including an optional native MCP bridge), the Kuna decompiler guide, and experimental Windows Ghidra support. Ghidra also supports 16-bit DOS analysis. For large binaries, raise the provider's startup deadline with REA_GHIDRA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS or REA_HOPPER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS. For provider selection, see the CLI guide. Check release availability for features added since the latest npm release. Showcases DX-Ball: reconstruct a sound-pan calculation Follow a sound call into its position-to-pan helper, inspect the instructions, and turn incomplete pseudocode into C. The reconstruction passes 3,205 original-x86 cases and reproduces all 63 compiled function bytes. Read the case study · Reconstruction repository Notion: trace the Electron clipboard bridge Find the renderer's clipboard API, follow it through preload and IPC into the main process, and inspect the rich clipboard format. Read the case study TH04: recover a DOS bullet-ring calculation Inspect the original PC-98 game's 16-bit instructions, recover the fixed and aimed angle calculations, and compare the reconstructed C++ with the historical compiler output. Read the case study · Reconstruction repository If you've used REA on something interesting, we'd love to see it. Share your case in an issue or a pull request, including the target, your question, how REA helped, and what you found. FAQ Which agents can use REA? Any agent that supports local MCP servers. Setup configures the supported agents; other clients can use manual MCP registration. Do I need Hopper, Ghidra or IDA? Deep native analysis uses one of them. Static JavaScript and .NET inspection work without a native analysis engine. Setup can install Hopper after approval; Ghidra and IDA use your existing installations. See provider setup. Do I need to start Hopper first? REA starts Hopper when an operation needs it. On macOS, a first-run dialog may ask you to choose demo mode or activate your license. Complete that prompt in the same user session before your first CLI/MCP operation or unattended job. Open Hopper manually if needed. See Hopper startup and troubleshooting. What does installing the skill from skills.sh do? The skill supplies investigation instructions for your agent. Use npx rea-agents setup to register REA's MCP server and install the matching instructions, then restart your agent. See skill-only installation. What code does REA return? Native analysis returns pseudocode and assembly. JavaScript/Electron analysis recovers modules and their relationships. Your agent uses these findings to write and test an implementation; the showcases give worked examples. Does REA upload my app? REA analyzes targets locally. Your agent receives the tool results, and its model provider has its own data policy. What should I do if I hit a bug? Update first; a recent release may already fix it. For a CLI installed with npm install --global or bun add --global: rea update For agent setup through npx: npx rea-agents@latest setup If you're using an agent, complete the setup refresh and restart it. Retry the same task. If the problem persists, open an issue with your REA version, target type, steps to reproduce and error output. Documentation Start with the website's worked guides. For exact options, prerequisites and result contracts: Installation and setup: agent registration, provider configuration, updates and uninstall. Readiness and troubleshooting: diagnose one agent or analysis engine. CLI and Evidence: commands, provider selection, snapshots, import/export and exit statuses. MCP contracts and agent prompts: tool results, sessions and guided investigations. Tool catalog: generated inventory of tools, providers and CLI commands. Roadmap: planned work and capability trackers. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md. Star history 🎉 250,000 GitHub stars — thank you! Thanks to everyone using REA, reporting bugs, requesting features, testing builds, and contributing fixes. Disclaimer See DISCLAIMER.md for responsible-use guidance. The project's position on illegal or unauthorized use covers all REA versions, distribution channels, and platforms; each copy retains its applicable licenses. REA is for lawful research, education, interoperability, software preservation, and analysis of software you own or are authorized to examine. Contributing We'd love your help with REA! Open an issue to report a bug or suggest a feature, or send a pull request to improve the code or docs. See CONTRIBUTING.md for development setup and checks, testing for verification lanes, and the architecture map for the project structure. License MIT REA-authored code is licensed under MIT. Third-party material retains its own licenses and copyright notices; see Third-party notices for the dependency inventory, preserved license texts, and external-tool terms. You must legally obtain and be authorized to use commercial tools, including IDA Pro / Hex-Rays decompilers, Hopper, and JEB, under their applicable licenses. REA grants no tool license, key, or activation entitlement. Trials and demos remain subject to vendor terms, including user, feature, automation, and output sharing restrictions. Cracked copies, stolen keys, unauthorized key sharing, and bypassing license restrictions are not authorized. This guidance does not amend MIT or third-party licenses.

For offline native-binary inspection, REA also supports caller-supplied GNU objdump and Rizin. See the reverse-engineering tools guide for provider setup, CLI commands, and Evidence limitations. REA does not install or update either provider. Native formats and host support vary by provider. See Hopper and Ghidra setup , the IDA guide (including an optional native MCP bridge), the Kuna decompiler guide , and experimental Windows Ghidra support . Ghidra also supports 16-bit DOS analysis . For large binaries, raise the provider's startup deadline with REA_GHIDRA_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS or REA_HOPPER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS . For provider selection, see the CLI guide . Check release availability for features added since the latest npm release. Showcases DX-Ball: reconstruct a sound-pan calculation Follow a sound call into its position-to-pan helper, inspect the instructions, and turn incomplete pseudocode into C. The reconstruction passes 3,205 original-x86 cases and reproduces all 63 compiled function bytes. Read the case study · Reconstruction repository Notion: trace the Electron clipboard bridge Find the renderer's clipboard API, follow it through preload and IPC into the main process, and inspect the rich clipboard format. Read the case study TH04: recover a DOS bullet-ring calculation Inspect the original PC-98 game's 16-bit instructions, recover the fixed and aimed angle calculations, and compare the reconstructed C++ with the historical compiler output. Read the case study · Reconstruction repository If you've used REA on something interesting, we'd love to see it. Share your case in an issue or a pull request , including the target, your question, how REA helped, and what you found. FAQ Which agents can use REA? Any agent that supports local MCP servers. Setup configures the supported agents ; other clients can use manual MCP registration . Do I need Hopper, Ghidra or IDA? Deep native analysis uses one of them. Static JavaScript and .NET inspection work without a native analysis engine. Setup can install Hopper after approval; Ghidra and IDA use your existing installations. See provider setup . Do I need to start Hopper first? REA starts Hopper when an operation needs it. On macOS, a first-run dialog may ask you to choose demo mode or activate your license. Complete that prompt in the same user session before your first CLI/MCP operation or unattended job. Open Hopper manually if needed. See Hopper startup and troubleshooting . What does installing the skill from skills.sh do? The skill supplies investigation instructions for your agent. Use npx rea-agents setup to register REA's MCP server and install the matching instructions, then restart your agent. See skill-only installation . What code does REA return? Native analysis returns pseudocode and assembly. JavaScript/Electron analysis recovers modules and their relationships. Your agent uses these findings to write and test an implementation; the showcases give worked examples. Does REA upload my app? REA analyzes targets locally. Your agent receives the tool results, and its model provider has its own data policy. What should I do if I hit a bug? Update first; a recent release may already fix it. For a CLI installed with npm install --global or bun add --global : rea update For agent setup through npx : npx rea-agents@latest setup If you're using an agent, complete the setup refresh and restart it. Retry the same task. If the problem persists, open an issue with your REA version, target type, steps to reproduce and error output. Documentation Start with the website's worked guides . For exact options, prerequisites and result contracts: Installation and setup : agent registration, provider configuration, updates and uninstall. Readiness and troubleshooting : diagnose one agent or analysis engine. CLI and Evidence : commands, provider selection, snapshots, import/export and exit statuses. MCP contracts and agent prompts : tool results, sessions and guided investigations. Tool catalog : generated inventory of tools, providers and CLI commands. Roadmap : planned work and capability trackers. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md . Star history 🎉 250,000 GitHub stars — thank you! Thanks to everyone using REA, reporting bugs, requesting features, testing builds, and contributing fixes. Disclaimer See DISCLAIMER.md for responsible-use guidance. The project's position on illegal or unauthorized use covers all REA versions, distribution channels, and platforms; each copy retains its applicable licenses. REA is for lawful research, education, interoperability, software preservation, and analysis of software you own or are authorized to examine. Contributing We'd love your help with REA! Open an issue to report a bug or suggest a feature, or send a pull request to improve the code or docs. See CONTRIBUTING.md for development setup and checks, testing for verification lanes, and the architecture map for the project structure. License MIT REA-authored code is licensed under MIT. Third-party material retains its own licenses and copyright notices; see Third-party notices for the dependency inventory, preserved license texts, and external-tool terms. You must legally obtain and be authorized to use commercial tools , including IDA Pro / Hex-Rays decompilers, Hopper, and JEB, under their applicable licenses. REA grants no tool license, key, or activation entitlement. Trials and demos remain subject to vendor terms, including user, feature, automation, and output sharing restrictions. Cracked copies, stolen keys, unauthorized key sharing, and bypassing license restrictions are not authorized. This guidance does not amend MIT or third-party licenses.

title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins Claude Code Plugins Directory A curated directory of high-quality plugins for Claude Code. ⚠️ Important: Make sure you trust a plugin before installing, updating, or using it. Anthropic does not control what MCP servers, files, or other software are included in plugins and cannot verify that they will work as intended or that they won't change. See each plugin's homepage for more information. Structure /plugins - Internal plugins developed and maintained by Anthropic /external_plugins - Third-party plugins from partners and the community Installation Plugins can be installed directly from this marketplace via Claude Code's plugin system. To install, run /plugin install {plugin-name}@claude-plugins-official or browse for the plugin in /plugin > Discover Contributing Internal Plugins Internal plugins are developed by Anthropic team members. See /plugins/example-plugin for a reference implementation. External Plugins Third-party partners can submit plugins for inclusion in the marketplace. External plugins must meet quality and security standards for approval. To submit a new plugin, use the plugin directory submission form. Plugin Structure Each plugin follows a standard structure: plugin-name/ ├── .claude-plugin/ │ └── plugin.json # Plugin metadata (required) ├── .mcp.json # MCP server configuration (optional) ├── commands/ # Slash commands (optional) ├── agents/ # Agent definitions (optional) ├── skills/ # Skill definitions (optional) └── README.md # Documentation Plugin names are immutable The name field in a marketplace entry is an immutable slug. Once a plugin has been published, its name must not change — users have it installed under that slug, and renaming it breaks their install with a plugin-not-found error. To change how a plugin is labeled in the UI, set or update displayName instead. If a rename is genuinely unavoidable, add an entry to the top-level renames map in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json so existing installs auto-migrate: "renames": { "old-name": "new-name" } The Claude Code plugin loader reads this map and transparently rewrites the old slug to the new one on the user's next sync. Skill-bundle plugins When a plugin's source repository ships skills (SKILL.md files) without a .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest, the marketplace entry can declare the skills directly using strict: false and an explicit skills array. { "name": "example-bundle", "description": "Brief description of the bundled skills.", "author": { "name": "Author Name" }, "category": "development", "source": { "source": "git-subdir", "url": "https://github.com/example-org/sdk.git", "path": "packages/agent-skills", "ref": "main", "sha": " " }, "strict": false, "skills": [ "./skill-a", "./skill-b", "./skill-c" ], "homepage": "https://github.com/example-org/sdk" } Each path in skills is relative to source.path and points at a directory containing a SKILL.md. Paths can reach deeper than a single level — for example, ["./libA/skill-1", "./libB/skill-2"] exposes a curated subset across multiple library subdirectories. Each skill is registered as : in Claude Code. For the underlying schema, see Strict mode in the marketplace documentation. License Please see each linked plugin for the relevant LICENSE file. Documentation For more information on developing Claude Code plugins, see the official documentation.
